source: WSELOB-2017 CC BY 4.0 complete HDF daily partitions
scope: Fresh-date evaluation after stage010 generator audit; old diagnostics not reused as confirmatory evidence
date_split: Jan16 train / Jan17 validation / Jan18 test, five stocks
stock_split: Five folds; held-out stock test, next alphabetical stock validation, other three train; all dates
combined_split: Same held-out-stock folds, plus Jan16 train / Jan17 validation / Jan18 test
style_split: Date split plus staggered positive style held out of train/validation and layered positives excluded from test
fusion_batch: 128 background/benign + 128 positive, oversampling only when class <128
supervision: Identical generated training labels for all supervised fusion variants; unsupervised controls get no positive labels for fitting
lob_architecture: Preserved JFDS TransformerAutoencoder, portable teacher-forced decoder; d_model64 dim_ff128 layers2 heads8
selection: validation AP only, earliest trial breaks ties; no test-dependent method revision
threshold: conservative validation-negative order statistic for target 1% empirical FPR
primary: window average precision, paired across identical folds/seeds
uncertainty: paired stock-day cluster bootstrap where enough clusters; seeds alone are not independent market samples
paper_0675_comparison: Not directly comparable: different market, labels, prevalence, architecture budget, metrics/aggregation and split
supervised_controls: Identical labels and all available raw/manual/aligned inputs, six validation-only trials
missing_manual_handling: Eight unavailable fields remain zero in archived data but are omitted identically from every model input to avoid counting inactive parameters
numerical_backend: Cached float64 RBF kernels reused across identical nu/gamma trials; mathematical objective unchanged
native_pilot_policy: Stage010 native/cached outputs are diagnostic only and are never pooled with stage011 results
timing_control: Burst controls share per-order lifetime marginals; wave controls share lifetime multiset but permute level order; random observational collisions retained and counted
passive_order_rule: Merge base top-five and persistent active orders; reject entire injected window if any active order becomes marketable; no invented fills
flow_features: Per side/level added-at-current-price, removed-at-previous-price, and both coverage masks; absent price means zero only inside observed support
rank_ablation: Same coverage masks, replace price-matched volumes with same-rank volumes
l1_control: Same fusion/labels/budget, only best-level coverage-aware flows added to the paper-structure baseline
constant_feature_handling: Fit variance mask on training only; remove constant columns before selecting matched fusion width; save mask
